concept: Owning up to something you did, even when it's tempting to blame someone else
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character is tempted to blame someone else for a mistake, and chooses to own it instead
exercise.reflection_prompt: What was different about how the character felt after owning the mistake versus how blaming someone else might have felt?
exercise.practice: Student shares a time they owned up to something, or a time they wish they had

assessment.success_marker: student shares a specific example without minimizing or over-blaming themselves
